title: The battery is already inside
request: The seller calls this a cordless drill, but it is an S4 screwdriver. I need twelve furniture screws, have suitable bits, and my delivered maximum is 350 SEK. Is it complete?

evidence.text: Synthetic Northbank S4 documentation: suitable for the stated furniture screws, integrated rechargeable battery, charged through its supplied cable from a compatible 5 V 2 A supply. No removable A18 battery or C18-A charger is used.
Actual S4 plus supplied charging cable, 300.00 SEK delivered, no other charges. Works. Power supply not included.
My existing supply is documented compatible with the S4 cable and rated 5 V 2 A; I checked its exact label.

hard_failures.text: Invents a need to buy an A18 battery, C18-A charger, or another supply despite the applicable evidence.
Claims the provided specifications establish the condition of the actual used unit.

usefulness.text: Uses the exact S4 architecture and owned supply to assess completeness.
Gives the supported 300.00 SEK delivered total and remaining condition limit.

acceptable_outcomes: Complete on the supplied evidence for this narrow task, subject to ordinary used-unit condition uncertainty.
